name: quad-pendulum-swingup
$comment: Quadruple inverted pendulum on a cart: swing-up from hanging and balance. Plant: planar multibond bond graph (Prismatic2D rail, four Revolute2DCompliant joints with 1e8 N/m pivots, RigidBody2D cart and links), ideal force actuator with viscous rail friction and soft end stops. Firmware QuadCartCtrl at 1 kHz: hold until 1 s, feed-forward + discrete TVLQR along the offline collocation trajectory (T_s = 5 s), latched LQR once in the catch region. QuadCartMonitor: link angles, energy per link from the body twists and poses, the energy ledger.

plots.title: Stacked energy per link (J) and the UPRIGHT level

Energy ledger (J): E_tot, W_in, W_loss, E_tot - W_in + W_loss

options.text: **Swing-up and balance.** From hanging at rest the cart follows an offline-optimised trajectory (feed-forward + time-varying LQR, **SWINGING UP**) and the 1 kHz LQR catches the chain upright (**BALANCING**). The stacked plot shows the energy of every link (kinetic + potential from the hanging rest) against the UPRIGHT level 4.32 J. The swing-up run takes about a minute: change an input, then press **Run**.
